html:
Ninh Binh is an attractive destination, with beautiful landscapes such as Trang An scenic area, Kim Son – Con Noi, Van Long lagoon… and many unique festivals with delicious and attractive dishes.

Traveling to Ninh Binh, visitors will visit the scenery of forests, mountains, rivers, seas with nature reserves, national parks, world biosphere reserves, a beautiful scene like a fairyland.

It can be said that Ninh Binh is the gateway to the North, a place with strong tourism development, with the routes Hanoi – Quang Ninh – Ninh Binh, or if visitors from other places travel to Ninh Binh by plane, they can go to Cat Bi, Noi Bai airport and then move to Ninh Binh to visit and sightsee.

If you have the opportunity to visit Ninh Binh, the destinations that tourists cannot miss are Trang An scenic area, Cuc Phuong National Park, Van Long lagoon… which are one of the indispensable destinations in the Ninh Binh tour itinerary regardless of the season of the year.

Ninh Binh, also known as Hoa Lu city, or Van Long wetland nature reserve, Con Noi town… is currently a friendly tourist destination attracting a large number of domestic and international tourists to visit and enjoy.

Especially Ninh Binh is home to many temples and shrines, especially the Hoa Lu ancient capital relic site, Trang An-Tam Coc-Bich Dong scenic spot, Non Nuoc Mountain, Trang An. The spiritual relic site of Bai Dinh Pagoda is located right on the mountainside and is a destination that attracts tourists to come here to worship in early spring…

Ninh Binh Eco-tourism Area

  • Ninh Binh is a place where forests, mountains, plains, seas… converge, including diverse eco-tourism areas such as Cuc Phuong National Park, a suitable destination for tourists who want to experience overnight camping.
  • Van Long Nature Reserve
  • Kenh Ga – Van Trinh Tourist Area
  • Tam Coc – Bich Dong such as Tam Coc, Bich Dong Pagoda, Thai Vi Temple, Thien Ha Cave…
  • Trang An Eco-tourism Area, which was recognized by UNESCO as a world heritage site in 2014.
  • Thung Nham – Bird Garden and mysterious caves such as Vai Gioi Cave, Ong But Cave, Tien Ca Cave, Thuy Cung Cave… or tourist attractions such as: Bai Ngang, Con Noi, Con Mo, Ne Island, Kim Son mangrove forest, Kim Dong seafood market, Kim Trung Church, Kim Son general port.

Accommodation in Ninh Binh, visitors can choose motels, homestays or hotels or high-class resorts. Ninh Binh is a place of tourism development, so there are many resorts that meet 5-star standards, but it all depends on the budget of visitors.

Shopping areas in Ninh Binh you should know such as: Southeast Asia Supermarket, Hapro Mart Ninh Binh Supermarket, Vinmart Ninh Binh Supermarket, Kien Anh Supermarket, Big C Ninh Binh Supermarket, Dong Thanh Supermarket, Ninh Binh Dragon Market, Dong Giao Doveco Supermarket, Pico Supermarket…

addition, if you want to visit the park, go to Non Nuoc Mountain Park, Ngoc My Nhan Mountain Forest Park, Tam Diep Green Park, Van River Park, Trang An Cultural Park, Ninh Binh National Wildlife Park and Dong Chuong Lake Park.

Festivals taking place in Ninh Binh during the year, Ninh Binh is home to many unique festivals but the main festivals take place in spring, including: Hoa Lu Cave Traditional Festival; Hoa Lu Festival; Thai Vi Temple Festival, Trang An Festival and Tran Ninh Binh Temple Festival, Nguyen Cong Tru Temple Festival… and Christmas at Phat Diem Church.

Ninh Binh Cuisine

It can be said that Ninh Binh is not only known for its famous landscapes, but this place also welcomes visitors with delicious and attractive dishes such as: Mountain goat, Kim Son wine, Tong Truong perch, Ninh Binh burnt rice, and delicious dishes that visitors should enjoy at least once in their life such as: Dong Giao pineapple, Kim Son vermicelli with meatballs, Yen Mac spring rolls, Gia Vien shrimp paste, Van Long grilled banana fish, Nho Quan wine, Hoang Long potatoes, Phat Diem eel vermicelli…. and many more interesting things are waiting for visitors to discover.
